Description: A powerful audio-focused plugin for capturing, recording, playing, and sampling audio. Sound Deck also includes actions for controlling audio devices and application audio, such as changing the default device or volume and controlling media playback.
Name: Sound Deck

com.geekyeggo.sounddeck.appmultimediacon.Name: App Media Controls
com.geekyeggo.sounddeck.appmultimediacon.Tooltip: Control media playback for a specific application.

com.geekyeggo.sounddeck.setappaudiodevic.Name: Set App Audio Device
com.geekyeggo.sounddeck.setappaudiodevic.Tooltip: Set the default audio device for an application.

com.geekyeggo.sounddeck.setappvolume.Name: Set App Volume
com.geekyeggo.sounddeck.setappvolume.Tooltip: Set the volume of an application.

com.geekyeggo.sounddeck.setaudiodevicevo.Name: Set Audio Device Volume
com.geekyeggo.sounddeck.setaudiodevicevo.Tooltip: Set the volume of an audio device.

com.geekyeggo.sounddeck.clipaudio.Name: Clip Audio
com.geekyeggo.sounddeck.clipaudio.Tooltip: Save the last precious seconds of audio so you never miss a funny moment again.

com.geekyeggo.sounddeck.playaudio.Name: Play Audio
com.geekyeggo.sounddeck.playaudio.Tooltip: Play one or more audio clips in the order you choose.

com.geekyeggo.sounddeck.stopaudio.Name: Stop Audio
com.geekyeggo.sounddeck.stopaudio.Tooltip: Stop all audio being played through Sound Deck.
